translations.web: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”
translations.bsb: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
translations.kjv: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
